messages:
zoe_newrep: Hi all, I'm Zoe (new AE). I can't get into Salesforce (SSO error) and Dialpad shows 'no extension'. Also missing the sales one-pager and call script. Who should I ping?

sam_ops: welcome @zoe_newrep! tag me. did you complete the onboarding checklist link in the welcome email? that triggers provisioning.

zoe_newrep: I filled the checklist but may have skipped the "request app access" step. SSO step redirects then shows "There was a problem completing your sign in" on Salesforce.

sam_ops: ok I'll open a ticket. @it-bot can you create ticket for Salesforce SSO + Dialpad seat + sales collateral access for zoe_newrep? role=AE

it-bot: Ticket created: IT-2576  "Provision: zoe_newrep  Salesforce SSO, Dialpad extension, Sales drive". SLA: 3 business hours. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/IT-2576

ben_sdr: hey Zoe, while ops sorts that, you can install the Dialpad mobile app and use it for calls. also the quick cold-open VM script i use: `Hi, this is Ben at Redwood Inference. We help teams ship LLM features faster and cheaper. Can I grab 10 min next week to share a quick idea?`

zoe_newrep: thanks @ben_sdr, mobile helps. any pointer to the one-pager?

sam_ops: one-pager here: https://redwood.example.com/sales/one-pager-intro (internal). call scripts and objection-handling cheatsheet are in the drive: /sales/collateral. i'll add you to that folder once ticket completes.

it-bot: IT-2576 update: Assigned to rachel-salesadmin. Salesforce SSO logs show missing group-mapping for role AE. Dialpad seat pending license assignment.

zoe_newrep: ok noted. also do we have a standard voicemail template?

ben_sdr: voicemail: `Hi, this is [Your Name] at Redwood Inference. Sorry I missed you. Please leave your name and the best number to reach you and Ill follow up within one business day.` keeps it short.

sales-ops-bot: Pro tip: set your HubSpot call logging to auto-cc redwood-sales@redwood.com so recordings land in the drive.

it-bot: IT-2576 status: Completed. Salesforce group mapping fixed, SSO working. Dialpad extension assigned (EXT-4421) and desktop app provisioned. Access to /sales/collateral granted. Closed by rachel-salesadmin at 2026-03-23T18:20:10Z.

zoe_newrep: confirmed I can login to Salesforce and Dialpad on desktop. got added to the drive, saw the one-pager and scripts. thanks everyone!

sam_ops: welcome aboard! i'll schedule a 30-min onboarding walkthrough tomorrow to show playbooks and role-specific sequences. tagging #sales-playbooks for any follow-ups.

onboarding-bot: Welcome DM sent to zoe_newrep with quickstart checklist, links, and a calendar for onboarding walkthrough: https://cal.com/redwood/sales-onboard-30
